rule: Observed-active lane of scale_A amendment 001 (crc_obs of risk_upgrade amendment 004), applied to every three-point arm of this protocol: a design whose measured three-point endpoint measured_only >= 3 is released with call active at every margin; any other design is released iff its exact margin > lambda.
limitations: Retrospective replay on previously studied public data; technical batches are separated by identity split R1 only.
Cutoff and rank reference were fitted on random-start scores of the arm and stay fixed for every start.
recommended and recommended_wells choose the start and its margin on the same calibration identities; recommended_split keeps the finite-sample statement.
Intervals condition on fitted pipelines, margins and selected starts; no refitting or reselection uncertainty, no multiplicity correction.
The 35-start test table and the ceiling rule are descriptive; no start is chosen from them.
The lane releases designs whose measured points already reach the activity line; such releases are correct by construction of the reference.
